description: A nonempty \(L\)-structure \(M\) is \(\kappa\)-saturated when every complete one-type over \(\operatorname{Th}(M_A)\), for every actual parameter subset \(A\subseteq M\) with \(|A|<\kappa\), is realized in \(M\). The bound concerns parameters, with no restriction on the size of the language or the type.
